## Brand Strategy
- No explicit brand strategy section; the document is a pure visual identity system focused on mark, color, typography, and application rules.

## Logo
- Custom wordmark ("The Art Institute of Chicago") with a distinctive lion icon.
- Outlined mark variant available for use at 0.5 in. width or larger.
- Clear space system uses cap height of the logo typography (V) as the unit; minimum clearspace is 2V, preferred is 0.5x (where x = full logo height).
- Scaling rules defined; social media and round mark variants provided.
- Integrity rules (do's/don'ts) included.

## Typography
- **Primary sans-serif:** Ideal Sans (H&FJ / Hoefler&Co.)
- **Primary serif:** Sabon Next
- Application rules, standard type scale, figure style guidance, and typographic don'ts all covered across several pages.

## Color
- **Primary palette:** Red (Hex #B50938, Pantone 7427C/U), White (#FFFFFF), Black (#000000). Red is described as the core identity color bringing "emotional warmth."
- Secondary and tertiary palettes referenced (pages 14-15).
- Neutrals palette referenced (page 16).
- Contrast rules defined (page 17).
- Full CMYK, RGB, Hex, and Pantone specs provided for primaries.
